title: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
script:
Jack Dorsey's Block just launched a new AI model called Dessa.
It mimics human conversation with a surprisingly awkward personality.
Dessa lead Ragavan Thurairatnam says the model was trained from scratch on human conversations.
The team shared transcripts showing the AI struggling with social cues.
It sounds less like a polished assistant and more like a nervous acquaintance.
Would you feel comfortable talking to an AI that sounds this uncertain?
